decision.summary: A broad asymmetric platform-like feature in N and E between indices 525–540: N exhibits a sustained rise followed by plateau; E shows delayed onset and only partial recovery, with no clear return to baseline before end of allowed context (575). U shows no coherent offset. The incomplete reversal prevents confirmation of a temporary offset; status is uncertain. No other temporary offsets observed in allowed context [485,575].

intervals.observation: N rises steadily from ~525 to ~535 then flattens; E shows delayed rise starting ~528 and partial return after ~536, but no full reversal to pre-onset level by 540. U remains quiet. Return is incomplete/ambiguous within allowed context.
